name: questions.nfrs.baseline
description: Baseline questions for non-functional requirements: availability, performance, scale, DR.

questions.text: What is the required availability SLA (or target SLO) for the main workload?
questions.rationale: Availability target drives topology cost, DR strategy, and operational staffing model.

questions.text: What are the primary latency / throughput targets for critical user journeys?
questions.rationale: Latency targets gate architectural decisions — caching, read-models, geographic distribution.

questions.text: What scale is the system expected to handle (users, QPS, data volume)?
questions.rationale: Scale ceiling steers technology choices and whether current baselines are 10× or 100× headroom.

questions.text: What are the disaster recovery RPO and RTO targets?
questions.rationale: RPO/RTO drive backup strategy, multi-region requirements, and test rituals (game days).

questions.text: Are there data residency or regional-isolation requirements?
questions.rationale: Residency constraints can invalidate default cloud service choices overnight.
